name: Example: Full-Stack React/Node.js Template
content:
FRONTEND ARCHITECTURE:
- Use React 18+ with TypeScript for type safety and better developer experience
- Implement component-based architecture with reusable UI components
- Use React Router for client-side routing and navigation
- Implement Redux Toolkit for state management with proper slice patterns
- Use React Query/TanStack Query for server state management and caching
- Follow atomic design principles for component organization
- Use CSS Modules or Styled Components for component styling

BACKEND ARCHITECTURE:
- Use Node.js with Express.js framework for REST API development
- Implement layered architecture: Controllers, Services, Repositories, Models
- Use TypeScript for backend development with strict type checking
- Implement PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM for database operations
- Use Redis for caching and session management
- Follow RESTful API design principles with proper HTTP methods and status codes

DEVELOPMENT PRACTICES:
- Use monorepo structure with separate packages for frontend, backend, and shared types
- Implement comprehensive testing with Jest and React Testing Library
- Use ESLint, Prettier, and Husky for code quality and formatting
- Follow Git flow with feature branches and pull request reviews
- Implement continuous integration with automated testing and deployment
- Use semantic versioning and conventional commits

SECURITY & AUTHENTICATION:
- Implement JWT-based authentication with refresh token rotation
- Use bcrypt for password hashing with proper salt rounds
- Implement role-based access control (RBAC) for authorization
- Use HTTPS everywhere with proper SSL/TLS configuration
- Implement input validation and sanitization on both client and server
- Use CORS properly with specific origin configuration
- Implement rate limiting and request throttling

DATA MANAGEMENT:
- Design normalized database schema with proper relationships
- Use database migrations for schema version control
- Implement proper indexing for query optimization
- Use database transactions for data consistency
- Implement soft deletes for data retention
- Use database connection pooling for performance

TESTING STRATEGY:
- Write unit tests for all business logic with >85% coverage
- Implement integration tests for API endpoints
- Use end-to-end testing with Cypress or Playwright
- Implement visual regression testing for UI components
- Use mock service worker (MSW) for API mocking in tests
- Implement performance testing and monitoring

DEPLOYMENT & INFRASTRUCTURE:
- Use Docker for containerization with multi-stage builds
- Implement CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI
- Use environment-specific configuration management
- Implement proper logging with structured JSON format
- Use monitoring and alerting with proper metrics collection
- Implement backup and disaster recovery procedures
